# Orator

> Orator is a web-based public-speaking practice app and voice-following teleprompter built by Corenator. It helps people rehearse aloud, follow their text word by word, and improve delivery with clear feedback.

## About

Orator is for anyone preparing to speak with more confidence, including students, job seekers, educators, presenters, creators, founders, faith leaders, and people practicing a new language. Users can bring their own speech or choose a sample passage and practice using a microphone.

## Features

- Voice-following teleprompter that highlights words as the user reads aloud.
- Guided speech practice with feedback on pace, clarity, filler words, and pauses.
- Core reading-room practice is free.
- Orator Plus features include saved passages and a personal library, voice typing, sentence focus, reading appearance controls, and expanded delivery analytics.
- Supported practice languages include English, Spanish, French, German, and Brazilian Portuguese, with regional options listed in the app.
- An account is required to use Orator. Live speech recognition depends on browser support and microphone permission.

## Pricing

The pricing page lists Orator Plus subscriptions at $2.99 per week, $5.99 per month, or $71.88 per year (USD). Core practice remains free. Check the pricing page for current rates and plan details.
